name: prototype
description: Builds throwaway code to answer a design question before committing to architecture: a logic facet (an interactive terminal app over a portable state model), a UI facet (radically different visual variants on one route), and a user-invoked generator facet (a throwaway tool the person tunes, whose saved output goes into the project).

level.title: Level
level.description: The level a /prototype:explore-directions run takes when the request names none: sketch, standard or full, or a level your repository's docs/conventions/prototype.yaml adds. Unset is standard. A repository's prototype.yaml wins over this option; see the plugin's reference/config.md.
